changelog: Sign in to new Microsoft accounts right from the in-game account switcher.
Remove accounts with the X, in the game and in the launcher.
The launcher shows each account's status (Ready, Checking, Sign in again, Can't reach Microsoft) and renews sign-ins automatically.
Sign-ins are now stored encrypted by Windows, and the game no longer reads a plain-text accounts file.
New AitoClient logo in the launcher, the game and the installer.
New night background for the main menu and the launcher, sharp at any screen size.
Dark Mojang loading screen, now in HD.
Sharper text, and menus sized properly on large and fullscreen windows.
New default HUD layout for new players.
The Armor Set HUD shows full set names, like Deadcurion Set and Wandering Champion Set.
Fixed adding an account in game removing your other accounts and keeping the old skin.
Fixed the main menu losing its dark look after leaving a world.
Fixed fly boost staying on with Toggle Sprint turned off.
Fixed the Pots counter disappearing on smaller windows.
Fixed the game failing to start for some players with their own Minecraft install; there's no need to rename .minecraft anymore.
